title: Candidate provenance, stratified sampling, and scalable eval hooks for rerank endpoint
creator: Claire Nguyen
description:
Problem statement: Our reranking endpoint produces high variance in offline quality metrics when comparing customer prompt sets to production traffic. Current NDCG/MRR tracking is coarse-grained and expensive to compute at scale. We need a low-latency, low-cost telemetry and eval hook system that preserves candidate provenance, supports stratified (promptset-aware) sampling, and provides A/B hooks for statistical comparisons with minimal impact to latency SLOs.

Goals:
- Add compact candidate_provenance metadata to each request/response so offline evals can reconstruct full candidate pipelines (embedding source, retrieval strategy, reranker variant, any augmentations).
- Implement stratified reservoir sampling keyed by customer prompt set and traffic slice to produce balanced evaluation cohorts (avoid skew towards high-volume customers).
- Expose lightweight A/B test hooks (assignment + deterministic hashing) that record variant, rollout stage, and can be toggled without deploys.
- Stream aggregated NDCG and MRR summaries per prompt set with incremental updates (approximate counting sketch) to avoid per-request heavy computations.
- Provide offline re-play tooling that can rehydrate sampled requests with exact candidate lists using provenance metadata so evaluations are deterministic.

Non-goals:
- This ticket does not replace full-scale offline eval pipelines (we will integrate with those later).
- We will not change model scoring itself here, only signals and scaffolding for evaluation and sampling.

Acceptance criteria:
- Candidate provenance schema added to rerank API debug payload and persisted in sampled telemetry events (max 2KB per event).
- Sampling system returns balanced sample by prompt set within 5% of target proportions over 100k requests in staging.
- End-to-end A/B hook toggles via Console feature flag and recorded variants appear in telemetry within 30s of toggle.
- Streaming NDCG/MRR shows per-prompt-set deltas for the last 24h in Grafana and aligns with offline batch recomputation within 2% error for NDCG@10 on the sampled cohort.
- End-to-end latency impact on P50 P95 for rerank endpoint <= +15ms and P99 <= +35ms.

Instrument rerank service to emit provenance on sampled events
Build stratified reservoir sampler library and integrate into request pipeline
Add A/B assignment hooks with Console toggle and rollout metadata
Implement streaming NDCG/MRR aggregator using time-windowed sketches
Add replay utility that reconstructs candidate list from provenance for offline evals
Add Grafana dashboard panels and alert for drift between streaming vs offline metrics
Write unit/integration tests and performance bench harness
implementation_notes:
Provenance fields: candidate_ids (list), retrieval_strategy (string, e.g., sparse/embedding/fusion), embedding_model (string), retrieval_hash (string), candidate_scores (list floats, optional compressed), reranker_model_tag (string), augmentation_tags (list). We will compress candidate_scores and candidate_ids using base64 zlib payload when > 512 bytes. The sampler will maintain per-promptset reservoirs using deterministic hashing of request.user_id or session_id; if both absent, fall back to monotonic sampler with time-decay. Streaming NDCG/MRR will use per-promptset Count-Min sketches + top-K histogram buckets to keep memory bounded.

Performance trade-offs: full provenance increases event size; to limit cost we only persist full provenance for sampled events (sample rate configurable per-promptset, default 0.5%). Non-sampled events will keep a 64-bit provenance fingerprint to enable coarse replays.

Operational playbook: if streaming vs offline drift > 5% for two consecutive hours, mark sampling increase for affected prompt sets and trigger a replay job. Default emergency knob in Console to disable provenance emission if egress cost spike is detected.
risks: Increased telemetry egress costs if sample rates are misconfigured
Deterministic sampling relies on stable user/session ids; anonymous traffic may skew sampling
Incorrect provenance compression could break replay determinism
A/B hooks added to hot path may introduce subtle latency regressions if not carefully async
qa_plan: Unit tests for sampler determinism, reservoir balance simulation
Staging canary: enable provenance and sampling for 1% of traffic and validate sample composition
Synthetic replay tests using stored provenance to ensure reconstructed candidate lists match live outputs
Load test to validate latency budget across prefixes and P99 under 2k RPS
End-to-end check: compare streaming NDCG/MRR vs offline recompute on sampled backlog
comments: 2025-01-15 - Diego Morales: Initial spike; prototyped provenance schema and validated that compressed payloads average 800 bytes for top-50 candidates. Need to tighten compression to meet 2KB cap. Action: try delta-encoding candidate ids.
2025-01-22 - Claire Nguyen: PM review — prioritize stratified sampling by prompt set; ensure ability to set per-customer sample rates for high-value accounts. Marking as P1.
2025-01-29 - Rohit Singh (SRE): Observability note — streaming aggregator needs backpressure protection. Suggest implementing bounded in-memory queues and backfill to kinesis when overloaded.
2025-02-03 - Diego Morales: Implemented sampler library and unit tests. Reservoir balance simulation shows <= 3% deviation for synthetic traffic. Submitted PR for review.

2025-02-07 - Review feedback from Claire: Add explicit customer_impact field to telemetry so PMs can filter by SLA customers in dashboards. Also request per-promptset retention of 30d for replayable samples.

2025-02-12 - QA (Anya Patel): Staging canary at 0.5% sample rate for 24h. Observed 9ms median added latency and 28ms at P99; within budget. Found a bug with provenance compression causing candidate order mismatch in rare cases — tracking fix in sub-issue ENG-90743.
2025-02-15 - Diego Morales: Updated streaming aggregator to use time-windowed sketches and pushed Grafana panels. Preparing rollout plan to enable on beta customers next cycle.
